name: exact_polynomial_gate.py
mathematical_scope: Constructs cyclotomic integral sparse polynomials for a denominator-cleared selected 9x9 minor, factoring it as -DB*DH via 3x3 and 6x6 determinants. Restricts to fixed N=8 shuffle and regular h0*Delta*T!=0 chart.
input_and_guard_coverage: Assumes canonical sparse monomial representation and exact imported arithmetic. remap checks variable-index set; det_sparse checks square rows. Prints max degree without empty-output protection. No generic validation of dependency equation/field conventions.
costs: Subset determinant dynamic programming O(n*2^n) polynomial multiplications, but support growth and integer bit lengths dominate actual work. This fixed small certificate does not yield an asymptotic transform algorithm.
test_evidence: 36 seeded modular comparisons plus two declared slice values, when run. These compare independent determinant routes but reuse dependencies; they do not themselves prove an integral identity at all coefficients.
acceptance_boundary: Construction is an exact symbolic recipe under verified arithmetic/equation identities; it yields necessary regular-chart conditions only. Stored/generated exports require exact coefficient reconciliation.
findings: L107–116 serializes full coefficients but accepts based on assert-backed sampled cross-checks. Exact dependency closure is outside these 24 assigned hashes.
